common_rules.decision_time: Every predictor value must be available at or before the recorded decision timestamp; option/derived predictors must use publication/availability timestamps when distinct from event timestamps.
common_rules.duplicate_rows: Deduplicate only byte-identical (instrument, exchange timestamp, interval) rows; conflicting duplicate rows block the affected fold/source.
common_rules.holdout: No untouched holdout path/secret is opened in this registry or empirical walk-forward run; fresh-forward remains a separate later gate.
common_rules.missing_target_rows: Exclude and count; block if target-pair missingness exceeds 1% of the session-eligible rows.
common_rules.price_provenance: NIFTY spot/index observations only for labels; option/derived rows may be predictors but never replace target spot prices.
common_rules.purge_embargo: Use each label's horizon-specific purge and embargo. Also remove any training label interval intersecting validation. Calibration/inner folds use identical horizon-specific rules.
common_rules.session_calendar: Use the official NSE Capital Market equities regular-session calendar snapshot pinned below before label generation; reconcile it against observed SPOT session dates and fail closed on contradictions or missing scheduled sessions.

labels.definition: Sign of NIFTY spot simple return from the forecast decision spot price to the spot price 5 minutes later.
labels.flat_treatment: Exclude if absolute simple return <= 1e-8; report exclusion counts by fold/source.
labels.fold_endpoint_rule: Score only when the horizon endpoint is within the same outer validation fold and the pinned dataset bounds.
labels.session_requirement: Decision timestamp and horizon-end timestamp must both lie inside the same official NSE trading session; exclude any row whose target endpoint crosses the session close; no overnight carry.
labels.target_maturity_rule: The target becomes observable only at decision_time + 5 minutes; training/calibration rows are usable only after that endpoint is known.

labels.definition: Sign of the NIFTY spot simple return from the decision-session close to the close after 1 complete following official NSE exchange sessions.
labels.flat_treatment: Exclude if absolute simple return <= 1e-8; report exclusion counts by fold/source.
labels.fold_endpoint_rule: Score only when the close after 1 following sessions lies inside the same outer validation fold and pinned dataset bounds. Drop the last 1 decision sessions of each fold from scoring.
labels.session_requirement: One decision observation at the registered session-close decision time. Use official exchange-session order, not calendar-day offsets.
labels.target_maturity_rule: The target becomes observable only after 1 complete following exchange sessions; any training/calibration target whose endpoint is not yet known at the cutoff is ineligible.

return_convention.equality_rule: flat when absolute simple return <= 1e-8; exclude flat labels from directional two-class scoring and report counts by fold/source.
return_convention.no_tuning: Flat tolerance cannot change after any outer-validation metric is computed.
